literal_meaning: আষাঢ় মাসে গল্প (story in the month of Asharh)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এটা তো আষাঢ়ে গল্প, কেউ বিশ্বাস করবে না।
বাচ্চারা আষাঢ়ে গল্প শুনে খুব উত্তেজিত হয়ে ওঠে।
example_sentences_in_english: That's just an Asharh tale, no one will believe it.
The children get excited hearing Asharh tales.
history: Originates from the tradition in East Bengal where during the heavy rains of Asharh month, children would pass lazy times listening to wondrous, joyful stories from their grandmothers (Thakurma); those days are no more.
note: The idiom evokes a sense of lost rural Bengali childhood traditions tied to the monsoon season.
